STRAIGHT.description: Match all three digits in exact order. One-dollar amounts mean a $1 base board, costing $2 with FIREBALL. Triples can produce three separate FIREBALL wins: $500 base plus 3 x $180 = $1,040. The official list offers Exact Order, Any Order, Exact/Any Order and Combo; no Pair play is listed.

BOX_3_WAY.description: Match all three digits in any order; two equal digits and one different digit (3 permutations). One-dollar amounts mean a $1 base board, costing $2 with FIREBALL. Each replacement position is evaluated separately.

BOX_6_WAY.description: Match all three digits in any order; three different digits (6 permutations). One-dollar amounts mean a $1 base board, costing $2 with FIREBALL. Each replacement position is evaluated separately.

STRAIGHT_BOX_3_WAY.description: 3-WAY Exact/Any Order: a $1 total base board allocates $0.50 to each component; cost is $2 with FIREBALL. An exact base match pays $330 combined; an any-order-only match pays $80. Payout rows separate EXACT_COMPONENT and ANY_COMPONENT, each normalized to the SAME $1 total board; add both components on an exact hit. Each FIREBALL exact-component hit also earns the any-component prize. Maxima refer to each component separately and need not occur together. Published total base-board costs are $1, $2, $4, $6, $8 and $10; wager_options gives the per-component amounts.

STRAIGHT_BOX_6_WAY.description: 6-WAY Exact/Any Order: a $1 total base board allocates $0.50 to each component; cost is $2 with FIREBALL. An exact base match pays $290 combined; an any-order-only match pays $40. Payout rows separate EXACT_COMPONENT and ANY_COMPONENT, each normalized to the SAME $1 total board; add both components on an exact hit. Each FIREBALL exact-component hit also earns the any-component prize. Maxima refer to each component separately and need not occur together. Published total base-board costs are $1, $2, $4, $6, $8 and $10; wager_options gives the per-component amounts.

COMBO_3_WAY.description: Cover all 3 distinct exact-order permutations on one ticket. One-dollar payout amounts mean $1 PER covered permutation, not $1 total ticket cost. Total base board cost at that amount is $3, doubled with FIREBALL. Only one base straight permutation wins.

COMBO_6_WAY.description: Cover all 6 distinct exact-order permutations on one ticket. One-dollar payout amounts mean $1 PER covered permutation, not $1 total ticket cost. Total base board cost at that amount is $6, doubled with FIREBALL. Only one base straight permutation wins.
